excerpt: An open-source iOS browser for developers. Test JavaScript web apps on iPhone with WebBluetooth (BLE/GATT) and WebNFC (NDEF tags). - hito-dev/wand-browser
content_html:
An open-source iOS browser for developers. Test JavaScript web apps on iPhone with camera video, WebBluetooth (BLE/GATT), and WebNFC (NDEF tags).

Install

App Store | TestFlight beta

Test your web app

Open your HTTPS site in Wand to test its Web Bluetooth or Web NFC code against nearby hardware.

  • Bluetooth Low Energy: select a device, connect to GATT services, read and write characteristics, and receive notifications through navigator.bluetooth.
  • NFC: read and write NDEF tags through NDEFReader.
  • Camera: request permission-controlled video through navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia().
  • History: reopen recent test pages from the home screen. Wand stores history on your device.

You choose which Bluetooth device a site can access and approve NFC requests. Hardware permissions end when you load a new document, reload, background Wand, or revoke access in Site controls.

Limits

This early version supports a subset of Web Bluetooth and Web NFC. Check the API calls your site uses against the bridge implementation. Hardware and camera access require a top-level HTTPS page with Wand in the foreground. NFC support is limited to NDEF tags.

Use a physical iPhone and compatible hardware for BLE and NFC tests. The simulator can test browser flows and bridge logic but cannot validate either radio.

Run

Requires iOS 18 or later. We tested builds with Xcode 26.6.

  1. Open ios/WandBrowser.xcodeproj.
  2. Select the WandBrowser scheme and an iPhone simulator or physical iPhone.
  3. For your own device build, choose your signing team and a unique bundle ID in Signing & Capabilities. Enable NFC Tag Reading for that App ID.
  4. Run the app.

Build the checked-in Xcode project directly. You do not need to generate it or install packages.

Test

In Xcode, choose Product → Test. The native and UI tests load hosted HTTPS fixtures. They need internet access. No local server or certificate setup is required.

Set the WAND_FIXTURE_URL build setting to use another HTTPS fixture host.

Node.js is optional. To run the standalone bridge and SDK tests from the repository root:

node --experimental-vm-modules --test tests/bridge.test.mjs

License

MIT.
